invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of an execute() call, so the return value should not be null under normal operation.
The input records list should be non-null for a bulk insert operation.
The context is required for any table operation and should never be null at method exit.
A valid instantTime string is required for write operations; should not be null at method exit.
The Option object should be non-null to represent the presence or absence of a partitioner.
